```tsx
  PlayingStateView, PoolPickChoiceRequiredPayload, ReanimationKitChoiceRequiredPayload, SpecialPickChoiceRequiredPayload,
  StealPickChoiceRequiredPayload, SubChoiceRequiredPayload,
} from '@card-battle/shared';
import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { renderUi } from '../../../test/render';
import { DISABLED_REASON_COPY } from '../../../view-model/action-reasons';
import { makeCard } from '../../../view-model/test-fixtures';
import type { ArenaCommit } from '../arena-commit';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from '../arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView, type ArenaPov } from '../test-view';
import { SubChoiceSheet } from './sub-choice-sheet';

const steal = (ids: readonly string[]): StealPickChoiceRequiredPayload =>
  ({ kind: 'steal-pick', victimPlayerId: 'p1', eligibleInstanceIds: ids, deadlineMs: 40_000 });
const pool = (ids: readonly string[]): PoolPickChoiceRequiredPayload =>
  ({ kind: 'pool-pick', eligibleInstanceIds: ids, maxCount: 2, deadlineMs: 40_000 });
const SPECIAL: SpecialPickChoiceRequiredPayload = { kind: 'special-pick', eligibleCardIds: ['cloning', 'block', 'poison'], deadlineMs: 40_000 };
const KIT: ReanimationKitChoiceRequiredPayload = { kind: 'reanimation-kit', eligibleKitIds: ['assassin', 'witch', 'ghost'], deadlineMs: 40_000 };
const POOL_VIEW = (): PlayingStateView => makeArenaView({ overrides: { pool: [
  makeCard('tax', { instanceId: 'pool-tax' }), makeCard('spy', { instanceId: 'pool-spy' }),
  makeCard('thief', { instanceId: 'pool-thief' }), makeCard('shield', { instanceId: 'pool-shield' }),
] } });

function setup(view: PlayingStateView, subChoice: SubChoiceRequiredPayload) {
  const onResolveSubChoice = vi.fn<ArenaScreenProps['onResolveSubChoice']>();
  const props = makeArenaProps({ view, subChoice, onResolveSubChoice });
  return { onResolveSubChoice, props, ...renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />) };
}
const sheet = (name: string): HTMLElement => screen.getByRole('dialog', { name });
const button = (dialog: HTMLElement, name: string): HTMLElement => within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name });
const pressedOf = (dialog: HTMLElement, names: readonly string[]): (string | null)[] =>
  names.map((name) => button(dialog, name).getAttribute('aria-pressed'));

describe('steal pick (§6.7, §6.3, L44-05)', () => {
  it('shows the Spy+ faces, preselects the first and sends the tapped instanceId', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView({ tiers: { p1: 'spy-plus' } }), steal(['p1-basic-attack', 'p1-spy']));
    const dialog = sheet('Steal a card');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Choose a card to steal from p1.')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(pressedOf(dialog, ['Basic attack', 'Spy'])).toEqual(['true', 'false']);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Spy'));
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm steal'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'steal-pick', instanceId: 'p1-spy' }]]);
  });

  it("a base-Spy steal shows only 'Hidden card' versos and never an instance id (Q54)", async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView({ tiers: { p1: 'base-spy' } }), steal(['stolen-a', 'stolen-b']));
    const dialog = sheet('Steal a card');
    const tiles = within(dialog).getAllByRole('button', { name: 'Hidden card' });
    expect(tiles.map((tile) => [tile.querySelector('[data-card-face]')?.getAttribute('data-card-face'), tile.getAttribute('aria-pressed')]))
      .toEqual([['hidden', 'true'], ['hidden', 'false']]);
    expect(tiles.map((tile) => tile.textContent)).toEqual(['Hidden card', 'Hidden card']);
    expect(dialog.outerHTML).not.toMatch(/stolen-[ab]/);
    const [, second] = tiles;
    if (second === undefined) throw new Error('no second tile');
    await user.click(second);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm steal'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'steal-pick', instanceId: 'stolen-b' }]]);
  });
});

describe('pool pick (§6.7, L44-05)', () => {
  it('offers only eligible pool cards, nothing preselected; extras grey at maxCount and Confirm needs exactly maxCount', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(POOL_VIEW(), pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-spy', 'pool-thief']));
    const dialog = sheet('Recover from pool');
    expect(pressedOf(dialog, ['Tax', 'Spy', 'Thief'])).toEqual(['false', 'false', 'false']);
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Shield' })).toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Select exactly 2 cards from the shared pool (0/2 selected).')).not.toBeNull();
    const confirm = button(dialog, 'Confirm recovery');
    expect(confirm.hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Tax'));
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Spy'));
    expect(button(dialog, 'Thief').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Thief'));
    expect(button(dialog, 'Thief').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false');
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Spy'));
    expect(button(dialog, 'Thief').hasAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe(false);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Thief'));
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Select exactly 2 cards from the shared pool (2/2 selected).')).not.toBeNull();
    await user.click(confirm);
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'pool-pick', instanceIds: ['pool-tax', 'pool-thief'] }]]);
  });

  it('shows the empty copy and never enables Confirm with no eligible card', async () => {
    const { user, props } = setup(POOL_VIEW(), pool([]));
    const dialog = sheet('Recover from pool');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('No eligible cards in the pool.')).not.toBeNull();
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm recovery'));
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
  });

  it('drops a pick a resend no longer offers, so Confirm waits for a new one (Review Focus 2)', async () => {
    const { user, props, rerender, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(POOL_VIEW(), pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-spy', 'pool-thief']));
    await user.click(button(sheet('Recover from pool'), 'Tax'));
    await user.click(button(sheet('Recover from pool'), 'Spy'));
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} subChoice={pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-thief'])} />);
    const dialog = sheet('Recover from pool');
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Spy' })).toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Select exactly 2 cards from the shared pool (1/2 selected).')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(button(dialog, 'Confirm recovery').hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Thief'));
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm recovery'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'pool-pick', instanceIds: ['pool-tax', 'pool-thief'] }]]);
  });

  it('keeps a dropped pick out when a later resend offers it again, so the count never exceeds maxCount (Review Focus 2)', async () => {
    const { user, props, rerender, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(POOL_VIEW(), pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-spy', 'pool-thief']));
    await user.click(button(sheet('Recover from pool'), 'Tax'));
    await user.click(button(sheet('Recover from pool'), 'Spy'));
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} subChoice={pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-thief'])} />);
    await user.click(button(sheet('Recover from pool'), 'Thief'));
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} subChoice={pool(['pool-tax', 'pool-spy', 'pool-thief'])} />);
    const dialog = sheet('Recover from pool');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Select exactly 2 cards from the shared pool (2/2 selected).')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(pressedOf(dialog, ['Tax', 'Spy', 'Thief'])).toEqual(['true', 'false', 'true']);
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm recovery'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'pool-pick', instanceIds: ['pool-tax', 'pool-thief'] }]]);
  });
});

describe('special pick (§6.7, L44-05)', () => {
  it('lists exactly the server specials by catalog name, the first preselected, and Confirm alone sends it', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView(), SPECIAL);
    const dialog = sheet('Choose a special');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Choose which special card to receive.')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(within(dialog).getByRole('list')).getAllByRole('button').map((tile) => tile.getAttribute('aria-label')))
      .toEqual(['Cloning', 'Block', 'Poison']);
    expect(pressedOf(dialog, ['Cloning', 'Block', 'Poison'])).toEqual(['true', 'false', 'false']);
    expect(within(dialog).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Card Transformer' })).toBeNull();
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm special'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'special-pick', cardId: 'cloning' }]]);
  });

  it('sends the tapped special', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView(), SPECIAL);
    await user.click(button(sheet('Choose a special'), 'Poison'));
    await user.click(button(sheet('Choose a special'), 'Confirm special'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'special-pick', cardId: 'poison' }]]);
  });
});

describe('Reanimation kit (§6.7, §11, L44-06, L26-02)', () => {
  it('shows kit tiles with portrait and name, aria-pressed on the first, and sends the tapped kit', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView({ pov: 'reanimating' }), KIT);
    const dialog = sheet('Choose a kit');
    expect(within(dialog).getByText('Choose which kit to revive with.')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(pressedOf(dialog, ['Assassin', 'Witch', 'Ghost'])).toEqual(['true', 'false', 'false']);
    expect(button(dialog, 'Witch').closest('[data-selected]')?.querySelector('img')?.getAttribute('alt')).toBe('Witch');
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Witch'));
    await user.click(button(dialog, 'Confirm kit'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'reanimation-kit', kitId: 'witch' }]]);
  });

  it.each<ArenaPov>(['eliminated', 'reanimating'])('renders for an eliminated POV (%s) and sends the first kit', async (pov) => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(makeArenaView({ pov }), KIT);
    await user.click(button(sheet('Choose a kit'), 'Confirm kit'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'reanimation-kit', kitId: 'assassin' }]]);
  });
});

describe('the commit lock (A.9.4; L74-25 sets it while reconnecting)', () => {
  it.each<{ title: string; confirm: string; view: () => PlayingStateView; subChoice: SubChoiceRequiredPayload }>([
    { title: 'Steal a card', confirm: 'Confirm steal', view: () => makeArenaView({ tiers: { p1: 'spy-plus' } }), subChoice: steal(['p1-basic-attack', 'p1-spy']) },
    { title: 'Choose a special', confirm: 'Confirm special', view: () => makeArenaView(), subChoice: SPECIAL },
    { title: 'Choose a kit', confirm: 'Confirm kit', view: () => makeArenaView({ pov: 'reanimating' }), subChoice: KIT },
  ])('a locked $title sheet disables $confirm with its reason and sends nothing', async ({ title, confirm, view, subChoice }) => {
    const commit = vi.fn<ArenaCommit>();
    const { user } = renderUi(<SubChoiceSheet subChoice={subChoice} view={view()} nowMs={0} commit={commit} actionReject={null} locked />);
    const locked = within(sheet(title)).getByRole('button', { name: confirm, description: DISABLED_REASON_COPY['actions-locked'] });
    expect(locked.hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
    await user.click(locked);
    expect(commit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

That is 14 tests (steal 2, pool 4, special 2, kit 3: one plus two `it.each` rows, lock 3 `it.each` rows; each row counts as one test, as Vitest reports it). The lock rows render `SubChoiceSheet` below `ArenaScreen` with a commit spy: the arena passes `locked` only from L74-25. The pool picker ORs `locked` into 'Confirm recovery' the same way; its Confirm is already disabled with no pick, so it has no row.

**Acceptance map:**
- Each kind sends the right payload shape: 'shows the Spy+ faces, …' (steal-pick), the pool Confirm assertions (pool-pick), both special tests (special-pick), both kit tests (reanimation-kit).
- A base-Spy steal shows only 'Hidden card' versos: "a base-Spy steal shows only 'Hidden card' versos and never an instance id (Q54)".
- Pool Confirm is enabled only at `maxCount`: 'offers only eligible pool cards, …' and 'shows the empty copy and never enables Confirm with no eligible card'.
- Kit tiles expose `aria-pressed`: 'shows kit tiles with portrait and name, aria-pressed on the first, …'.
- The kit prompt renders for an eliminated POV: 'renders for an eliminated POV (%s) and sends the first kit'.
- Part 2 Review Focus 2 (pool): 'drops a pick a resend no longer offers, so Confirm waits for a new one (Review Focus 2)' and 'keeps a dropped pick out when a later resend offers it again, so the count never exceeds maxCount (Review Focus 2)'.
- The commit lock reaches every picker (S4): 'a locked $title sheet disables $confirm with its reason and sends nothing'.
- `pnpm verify` green: Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **Lock (S4).** Every Confirm ORs the host's `locked`; the host's `send` already drops a locked answer, so the button state is what this task adds.
- **One tile primitive.** Steal, pool and special use L74-18's `ChoiceCardTile`; the kit picker uses the L72 `KitTile` (Appendix A `table-subchoice-reanimation-kit` keeps "no third picker primitive").
- **Pool order** is tap order, as V2 sent it. A pick that a resend drops leaves the selection instead of being replaced, so the player chooses again. `picked` is pruned to the offered ids in the render phase, so a dropped card stays out when a later resend offers it again, and the counter never exceeds `maxCount` (without the prune, a revived pick would read 3/2 and disable Confirm).
- **Special list** is rendered exactly as the server sends it; the client does not filter Card Transformer (golden rule 8).
- **Kit tiles carry no stats** (`stats={[]}`), as V2 showed only the portrait and name. **Designer question:** show each kit's starting lives and points on the tile? Default: no.
- **New strings:** none. Reused verbatim: 'Choose a card to steal from {victim}.', 'Hidden card' (`HIDDEN_CARD_LABEL`), 'Confirm steal', the pool counter and empty copy, 'Confirm recovery', 'Choose which special card to receive.', 'Confirm special', 'Choose which kit to revive with.', 'Confirm kit', catalog card and kit names.

```tsx
/**
 * Slot-drop as select + Drop: technical spec v7 §6.7, §13 Q42 / Q56, §14.3; Appendix A
 * `slot-drop-picker`, `table-subchoice-slot-drop`, `table-slot-drop-commit-cancel`,
 * `table-subchoice-wait-slot-drop`; server `cancelSlotDrop` (L74-20).
 */
import type { SlotDropChoiceRequiredPayload } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { renderUi } from '../../../test/render';
import type { ArenaCommit } from '../arena-commit';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from '../arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from '../test-view';
import { SubChoiceSheet } from './sub-choice-sheet';

const OWN: SlotDropChoiceRequiredPayload = {
  kind: 'slot-drop',
  slotOwnerPlayerId: 'me',
  eligibleSlots: [
    { kind: 'shield', id: 'slot-shield', cardId: 'shield', isUpgraded: false },
    { kind: 'persistent', id: 'slot-poison', cardId: 'poison', isUpgraded: false },
    { kind: 'sentence', id: 'slot-sentence', cardId: 'sentence', isUpgraded: false },
  ],
  deadlineMs: 40_000,
};
const CURSE: SlotDropChoiceRequiredPayload = { ...OWN, slotOwnerPlayerId: 'p2' };
const OWN_CANCEL = 'Cancel: the new card is not activated and stays in your hand or goes back to your specials. You keep your four active cards and can still act this turn.';
const CURSE_CANCEL = 'Cancel: your Curse is not cast and goes back to your specials. p2 keeps their four active cards, and you can still act this turn.';

function setup(subChoice: SlotDropChoiceRequiredPayload) {
  const onResolveSubChoice = vi.fn<ArenaScreenProps['onResolveSubChoice']>();
  const props = makeArenaProps({ view: makeArenaView(), subChoice, onResolveSubChoice });
  return { onResolveSubChoice, props, ...renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />) };
}
const dialog = (): HTMLElement => screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Drop an active card' });
const button = (name: string): HTMLElement => within(dialog()).getByRole('button', { name });

describe('slot-drop (§6.7 select + Drop, Q42 / Q56)', () => {
  it('lists one tile per eligible slot with the V2 captions; a tap selects and sends nothing', async () => {
    const { user, props } = setup(OWN);
    const names = ['Shield (shield)', 'Poison', 'Sentence (sentence)'];
    expect(names.map((name) => button(name).getAttribute('aria-pressed'))).toEqual(['false', 'false', 'false']);
    expect(button('Drop').hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
    await user.click(button('Poison'));
    expect(names.map((name) => button(name).getAttribute('aria-pressed'))).toEqual(['false', 'true', 'false']);
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
  });

  it('Drop sends the selected slotId once', async () => {
    const { user, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(OWN);
    await user.click(button('Shield (shield)'));
    await user.click(button('Drop'));
    await user.click(button('Drop'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'slot-drop', slotId: 'slot-shield' }]]);
  });

  it('opens a slot-drop that follows a clear with nothing pressed and Drop disabled', async () => {
    const { user, props, rerender } = setup(OWN);
    await user.click(button('Poison'));
    expect(button('Poison').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} subChoice={null} />);
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} subChoice={{ ...OWN }} />);
    expect(['Shield (shield)', 'Poison', 'Sentence (sentence)'].map((name) => button(name).getAttribute('aria-pressed'))).toEqual(['false', 'false', 'false']);
    expect(button('Drop').hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('Cancel sends cancel: true; Esc and the backdrop send nothing', async () => {
    const { user, props, onResolveSubChoice } = setup(OWN);
    await user.keyboard('{Escape}');
    const overlay = dialog().closest<HTMLElement>('[data-zone="sheet-overlay"]');
    if (overlay === null) throw new Error('no overlay');
    await user.click(overlay);
    expect(dialog()).not.toBeNull();
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
    await user.click(button('Cancel'));
    expect(onResolveSubChoice.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'slot-drop', cancel: true }]]);
  });

  it('own slots: the V2 prompt, your expiry hint and the own Cancel outcome', () => {
    setup(OWN);
    expect(within(dialog()).getByText('You have four active cards. Pick one to remove so the new card can stay.')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog()).getByText('On expiry: your oldest droppable active card is dropped', { exact: false })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel', description: OWN_CANCEL })).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('Curse on a full victim: the prompt, the expiry hint and the Cancel outcome name the victim, and the outcome differs', () => {
    setup(CURSE);
    expect(within(dialog()).getByText('p2 has four active cards. Pick one of theirs to remove so your Curse can land.')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog()).getByText("On expiry: p2's oldest droppable active card is dropped", { exact: false })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog()).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel', description: CURSE_CANCEL })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(CURSE_CANCEL).not.toBe(OWN_CANCEL);
  });

  it('locked keeps a tile tap selecting but disables Drop and Cancel, sending nothing; unlocked, Drop sends (A.9.4)', async () => {
    const commit = vi.fn<ArenaCommit>();
    const base = { subChoice: OWN, view: makeArenaView(), nowMs: 0, commit, actionReject: null } as const;
    const { user, rerender } = renderUi(<SubChoiceSheet {...base} locked />);
    await user.click(button('Poison'));
    expect(button('Poison').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true');
    expect([button('Drop').hasAttribute('disabled'), button('Cancel').hasAttribute('disabled')]).toEqual([true, true]);
    await user.click(button('Drop'));
    await user.click(button('Cancel'));
    expect(commit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    rerender(<SubChoiceSheet {...base} locked={false} />);
    await user.click(button('Drop'));
    expect(commit.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ kind: 'resolveSubChoice', payload: { kind: 'slot-drop', slotId: 'slot-poison' } }]]);
  });
});
```

That is 7 tests. The clear-then-new-prompt test is the slot-drop half of L74-18's host key: the key `slot-drop:me` is the same before and after the clear, so only the host's opening count keeps the earlier pick, and with it Drop enabled at once, out of the new prompt. The lock test renders `SubChoiceSheet` below `ArenaScreen` with a commit spy (the arena passes `locked` only from L74-25).

```
## YYYY-MM-DD · [P] V7 slot-drop: select then Drop, and Cancel states its outcome (L74-20)

Source: technical spec v7 §6.7, §13 Q42 / Q56, §14.3; Appendix A `table-subchoice-slot-drop`,
`table-slot-drop-commit-cancel`; server `engine/specials/slot-drop.ts` (`cancelSlotDrop`),
`engine/turn/perform-action.ts` (play payment, `cancelRestore`), `rooms/game-room.ts`
(`handleSlotDrop`, PR #82 / L82-01), `engine/turn/lot-69-rules.test.ts`.

- **Commit model.** V2 dropped the tapped slot at once. V7 makes a tap select (`aria-pressed`) and
  'Drop' send the selected `slotId`; nothing is preselected, because a drop removes a card for
  good. Appendix A `table-slot-drop-commit-cancel` allows this: the intent and payload are the same.
- **Cancel's outcome, read from the server.** `cancelSlotDrop` discards the pending activation,
  returns a card played from the specials to its holder's specials (a hand card never left the
  hand), and clears the prompt. The room then restarts the same seat's turn with a fresh clock
  (since PR #82 the state goes out after the new deadline), so the turn is not spent. The copy says
  so for each case: own slots ("the new card is not activated … you keep your four active cards")
  and the Curse caster ("your Curse is not cast … {victim} keeps their four active cards").
- **Points on Cancel (designer 2026-11-02: refund).** Cancel refunds the play's points. Today
  `cancelSlotDrop` refunds none (the cost was paid at play time), so this is a Classic rule change
  on the server, outside V7. Another session makes it, with the rules spec and this file, as an
  L82 task on its own branch into `dev`; the arena changes no code for it. The Cancel copy stays
  silent about points, so it reads true before and after that change lands.
- **Server fix, outside this lot.** A slot-cap peel used to pool a copy of the held card, so a
  Cancel or a Drop left it duplicated (Curse included). L82-02 (`fix(engine): stop pooling held
  fifth slot`) fixes it on its own branch into `dev`. The arena copy does not depend on it.

---
```

**Acceptance map:**
- Tapping a tile selects it and sends nothing: 'lists one tile per eligible slot with the V2 captions; a tap selects and sends nothing'.
- Drop sends the selected `slotId`: 'Drop sends the selected slotId once'.
- A slot-drop that opens after a clear starts with nothing pressed and Drop disabled (L74-18's host key, so one tap cannot drop a card for good from an earlier prompt's pick): 'opens a slot-drop that follows a clear with nothing pressed and Drop disabled'.
- Cancel sends `cancel: true`; Esc sends nothing: 'Cancel sends cancel: true; Esc and the backdrop send nothing'.
- The Curse variant copy names the victim: 'Curse on a full victim: the prompt, the expiry hint and the Cancel outcome name the victim, …'.
- The Cancel copy differs between the two cases: the same test, against 'own slots: the V2 prompt, your expiry hint and the own Cancel outcome'.
- Drop and the slot-drop Cancel lock with the host (S4): 'locked keeps a tile tap selecting but disables Drop and Cancel, sending nothing; unlocked, Drop sends (A.9.4)'.
- `decisions.md` entry for the commit model (§6.7): Step 5.
- `pnpm verify` green: Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **Nothing preselected; Drop disabled until a pick.** **Designer question:** preselect the oldest droppable slot (the timeout default)? Default: no, since a drop removes a card for good. The host's opening count (L74-18) keeps this true for a later prompt of the same owner, whose key is the same.
- **Buttons:** Drop `primary`, Cancel `secondary` (V2's Cancel was red). **Designer question:** default as listed.
- **Cancel outcome copy** (new, Designer question with these defaults):
  - own: 'Cancel: the new card is not activated and stays in your hand or goes back to your specials. You keep your four active cards and can still act this turn.'
  - Curse: 'Cancel: your Curse is not cast and goes back to your specials. {victim} keeps their four active cards, and you can still act this turn.'
- **Points on Cancel (Designer 2026-11-02: refund).** Cancel refunds the play's points. That is a Classic rule change on the server, outside V7: another session makes it, with the rules spec and `decisions.md`, as an L82 task on its own branch into `dev`. The arena changes no code for it. The Cancel copy stays silent about points, so it reads true before and after the server change lands (the L74-26 gate, G15, records which behaviour `dev` has).
- **Tile names** are the V2 captions without V2's 'Drop ' prefix, because a tile now selects; 'Drop' names the commit button.
- **New strings:** 'Drop', and the two Cancel outcome lines. Reused verbatim: 'Drop an active card', both V2 prompts, both expiry hints, '(shield)' / '(sentence)', 'Cancel'.

```ts
// arena-screen.tsx — the first widening (A.9.1). L74-23 adds `onReopenClaim?`, L74-25 `connectionStatus`.
export interface ArenaScreenProps extends TableScreenProps {
  /** L74-21: the raw TURN_STARTED payload; the arena records its receive time and turnSequence (§4.1). */
  lastTurnStarted: TurnStartedPayload | null;
  /** L74-21: this room's last lobby rules (App: `cachedLobbyRules(cache, view)`, this room, Classic only; EndScreen: `view.lobbyRules ?? null`); null when unknown. */
  cachedLobbyRules: LobbyRules | null;
}

// use-turn-started-record.ts
/** The first TURN_STARTED sighting of the current turn; a resume on the same turnSequence keeps it (§6.10). */
export function useTurnStartedRecord(input: {
  readonly lastTurnStarted: TurnStartedPayload | null;
  readonly turnSequence: number;
  /** `view.turnDeadlineMs`: at mount, only a payload for this deadline is recorded. */
  readonly turnDeadlineMs: number | null;
  readonly nowMs: number;
}): TurnStartedRecord | null;

// turn-clock.tsx
export interface TurnClockProps { readonly model: TurnClockModel }
export function TurnClock({ model }: TurnClockProps): ReactElement;

// top-bar.tsx — TopBarProps gains:
/** L74-21: `turnClock(...)`, computed once in ArenaScreenInner (Appendix A.2). */
clock: TurnClockModel;

// use-lobby-rules-cache.ts
export interface LobbyRulesCacheHandle {
  /** This room's last lobby rules (`nextRulesCache`), null when unknown. */
  readonly cache: RulesCache | null;
  /** Forget them now: the player left (a null view alone keeps them, `nextRulesCache`). */
  readonly clear: () => void;
}
export function useLobbyRulesCache(view: StateView | null): LobbyRulesCacheHandle;
```

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
/**
 * Turn clock in the top bar: technical spec v7 §4.1, §6.10, §14.3; Appendix A
 * `table-turn-timer-scale`, `turn-strip-timers`; L12-07 (cosmetic, the server deadline rules);
 * Lot 73 carry-forward (the countdown runs on during a post-action sub-choice) (L74-21).
 */
import {
  defaultLobbyRules,
  type LobbyRules,
  type PlayingStateView,
  type PublicPlayerView,
  type SubChoiceRequiredPayload,
  type TurnStartedPayload,
} from '@card-battle/shared';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { renderUi, type RenderUiOptions } from '../../test/render';
import { TURN_CLOCK_ABSENT_LABEL, TURN_CLOCK_NONE_LABEL, TURN_CLOCK_PAUSED_LABEL } from '../../view-model/turn-clock';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from './arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from './test-view';

const rules = (turnTimeSeconds: number): LobbyRules => ({ ...defaultLobbyRules(), turnTimeSeconds });
const started = (deadlineMs: number): TurnStartedPayload => ({ activePlayerId: 'me', deadlineMs, blockTurnsRemaining: 0 });
const MIRROR: SubChoiceRequiredPayload = { kind: 'mirror', eligibleEffectIds: [], deadlineMs: 1 };
const LINK = { disconnectedAt: 0, automaticTurnsTaken: 0, consecutiveTimeouts: 0 } as const;
const myTurn = (turnDeadlineMs: number | null, turnSequence = 4): PlayingStateView =>
  makeArenaView({ overrides: { turnDeadlineMs, turnSequence } });
function onSeat(view: PlayingStateView, patch: Partial<PublicPlayerView>): PlayingStateView {
  return { ...view, players: view.players.map((player) => (player.id === 'p1' ? { ...player, ...patch } : player)) };
}
const p1Turn = (turnDeadlineMs: number | null): PlayingStateView =>
  makeArenaView({ overrides: { currentTurnPlayerId: 'p1', turnDeadlineMs } });

function setup(overrides: Partial<ArenaScreenProps>, options: RenderUiOptions = {}) {
  const props = makeArenaProps(overrides);
  const result = renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />, options);
  const update = (next: Partial<ArenaScreenProps>): void => {
    result.rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} {...next} />);
  };
  return { ...result, props, update };
}
function clockPart(selector: string): Element {
  const found = document.querySelector(`[data-arena-region="top-bar"] [data-zone="timers"][data-hint-anchor="your-turn"] ${selector}`);
  if (found === null) throw new Error(`no ${selector} in the clock slot`);
  return found;
}
const label = (): string => clockPart('[data-zone="timer-label"]').textContent ?? '';
const bar = (): Element => clockPart('[role="progressbar"][aria-label="Turn timer"]');
const valueNow = (): string | null => bar().getAttribute('aria-valuenow');
const danger = (): boolean => clockPart('[data-zone="timer-label"]').hasAttribute('data-danger');

describe('turn clock (spec v7 §6.10, L74-21)', () => {
  it('scales the bar to a 180 s host turn: full at 180 s, half at 90 s (source 1)', () => {
    const { update } = setup({ view: myTurn(180_000), nowMs: 0, cachedLobbyRules: rules(180) });
    expect([label(), valueNow(), danger()]).toEqual(['180s', '100', false]);
    update({ nowMs: 90_000 });
    expect([label(), valueNow(), danger()]).toEqual(['90s', '50', false]);
  });

  it('starts a 5 s host turn full, in --danger for its last 10 s', () => {
    setup({ view: myTurn(5_000), nowMs: 0, cachedLobbyRules: rules(5) });
    expect([label(), valueNow(), danger()]).toEqual(['5s', '100', true]);
  });

  it('falls back to the first TURN_STARTED of the turn; a resume on the same turnSequence keeps its length (source 2, §4.1)', () => {
    const { update } = setup({ view: myTurn(30_000, 4), nowMs: 0, lastTurnStarted: started(30_000) });
    expect(valueNow()).toBe('100');
    update({ view: myTurn(30_000, 4), nowMs: 10_000 });
    expect(valueNow()).toBe('67');
    // Resume after a disconnect: a new payload on the same turnSequence, 20 s left of 30.
    update({ view: myTurn(70_000, 4), nowMs: 50_000, lastTurnStarted: started(70_000) });
    expect([label(), valueNow()]).toEqual(['20s', '67']);
    // The next turn records its own length.
    update({ view: myTurn(140_000, 5), nowMs: 80_000, lastTurnStarted: started(140_000) });
    expect([label(), valueNow()]).toEqual(['60s', '100']);
  });

  it('ignores a payload left from the previous game at mount, then records the new turn (Play again in one room)', () => {
    const { update } = setup({ view: myTurn(30_000, 1), nowMs: 0, lastTurnStarted: started(9_000) });
    expect(valueNow()).toBeNull();
    update({ view: myTurn(30_000, 1), nowMs: 0, lastTurnStarted: started(30_000) });
    expect(valueNow()).toBe('100');
  });

  it('shows seconds only, with no aria-valuenow, when no length is known (source 3)', () => {
    setup({ view: myTurn(42_500), nowMs: 0 });
    expect([label(), valueNow()]).toEqual(['43s', null]);
  });

  it.each<{ label: string; overrides: Partial<ArenaScreenProps>; text: string }>([
    { label: 'the active seat disconnected', overrides: { view: onSeat(p1Turn(30_000), { connection: { ...LINK, status: 'disconnected' } }) }, text: TURN_CLOCK_PAUSED_LABEL },
    { label: 'the active seat absent with no deadline', overrides: { view: onSeat(p1Turn(null), { connection: { ...LINK, status: 'absent' } }) }, text: TURN_CLOCK_ABSENT_LABEL },
    { label: 'a bot turn', overrides: { view: onSeat(p1Turn(null), { isBot: true }) }, text: TURN_CLOCK_NONE_LABEL },
    { label: 'the finished board', overrides: { view: myTurn(30_000), readOnly: true, cachedLobbyRules: rules(60) }, text: TURN_CLOCK_NONE_LABEL },
  ])('shows $text for $label, with an empty bar and no aria-valuenow', ({ overrides, text }) => {
    setup({ nowMs: 0, ...overrides });
    expect([label(), valueNow()]).toEqual([text, null]);
  });

  it('keeps counting down while a post-action sub-choice is open, as V2 did (Lot 73 carry-forward)', () => {
    setup({ view: myTurn(30_000), nowMs: 0, cachedLobbyRules: rules(60), subChoice: MIRROR });
    expect([label(), valueNow()]).toEqual(['30s', '50']);
  });

  it('sends nothing, and the fill jumps under reduced motion', () => {
    const { props, unmount } = setup({ view: myTurn(30_000), nowMs: 0, cachedLobbyRules: rules(60) });
    expect(bar().querySelector('[data-motion]')?.getAttribute('data-motion')).toBe('full');
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
    unmount();
    setup({ view: myTurn(30_000), nowMs: 0, cachedLobbyRules: rules(60) }, { reducedMotion: true });
    expect(bar().querySelector('[data-motion]')?.getAttribute('data-motion')).toBe('reduced');
  });
});
```

```ts
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
/**
 * App's lobby-rules cache: technical spec v7 §6.10 source (1), §6.11; `view-model/rules-recall.ts`
 * (L73-12) (L74-21). One `nextRulesCache` step per new view identity; leaving clears it.
 */
import { defaultLobbyRules, type StateView } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import './test/render'; // act environment and per-test cleanup (L72-06)
import { useLobbyRulesCache } from './use-lobby-rules-cache';
import { cachedLobbyRules } from './view-model/rules-recall';
import { makeLobbyView, makePlayingView } from './view-model/test-fixtures';

const RULES_180 = { ...defaultLobbyRules(), turnTimeSeconds: 180 };
const lobby = (gameCode: string, turnTimeSeconds = 180): StateView =>
  makeLobbyView({ gameCode, lobbyRules: { ...RULES_180, turnTimeSeconds } });

function setup(first: StateView | null) {
  return renderHook(({ view }: { view: StateView | null }) => useLobbyRulesCache(view), { initialProps: { view: first } });
}

describe('useLobbyRulesCache (L74-21)', () => {
  it("keeps the room's last lobby rules from the lobby into play, and drops them for another room", () => {
    const { result, rerender } = setup(lobby('ROOM01'));
    const playing = makePlayingView({ gameCode: 'ROOM01' });
    rerender({ view: playing });
    expect(cachedLobbyRules(result.current.cache, playing)?.turnTimeSeconds).toBe(180);
    rerender({ view: makePlayingView({ gameCode: 'ROOM02' }) });
    expect(result.current.cache).toBeNull();
  });

  it('keeps the rules through a null view, clears them on leave, and stays clear until a lobby view', () => {
    const { result, rerender } = setup(lobby('ROOM01'));
    rerender({ view: null });
    expect(result.current.cache?.rules.turnTimeSeconds).toBe(180);
    rerender({ view: makePlayingView({ gameCode: 'ROOM01' }) });
    act(() => {
      result.current.clear();
    });
    expect(result.current.cache).toBeNull();
    rerender({ view: makePlayingView({ gameCode: 'ROOM01' }) });
    expect(result.current.cache).toBeNull();
  });

  it('takes every new lobby view of the room, so Play again brings the edited rules', () => {
    const { result, rerender } = setup(lobby('ROOM01'));
    rerender({ view: lobby('ROOM01', 45) });
    expect(result.current.cache?.rules.turnTimeSeconds).toBe(45);
  });
});
```

That is 3 tests.

```
## YYYY-MM-DD · [P] V7 turn clock: TURN_STARTED receive time and the lobby-rules cache (L74-21)

Source: technical spec v7 §4.1, §6.10, §6.11, §14.3; Appendix A `table-turn-timer-scale`,
`turn-strip-timers`; `view-model/turn-clock.ts` (L73-13), `view-model/rules-recall.ts` (L73-12);
the Lot 73 final review carry-forward.

- **Receive time.** The arena records a sighting when `lastTurnStarted` changes identity, with
  the `turnSequence` of the view current in that render and `receivedAtMs = props.nowMs`. App's
  `nowMs` ticks every 250 ms, so the record can be up to 250 ms early: the length errs long by at
  most that much and the bar starts full. On a new turn the server sends the state before
  `TURN_STARTED`, so the view already carries the new `turnSequence`; a resume sends
  `TURN_STARTED` first on the same `turnSequence`, and `nextTurnStartedRecord` keeps the first
  sighting. If a `TURN_STARTED` ever came before its own turn's state, its record would carry the
  previous `turnSequence` and that turn would show seconds only, never a wrong bar (§14.3 watch
  point, checked at the L74-26 gate). At mount, a payload is recorded only when its deadline is
  the view's `turnDeadlineMs`: after Play again in one room the hook still holds the previous
  game's payload.
- **Post-action sub-choice.** The countdown keeps running while a Mirror, reward or pool pick is
  open after the POV acted, although the server cleared its turn timer (V2 parity). L79's tick
  must not rely on `tick` alone.
- **Lobby-rules cache.** App holds it (`useLobbyRulesCache`): one `nextRulesCache` step per new
  view identity, because a lobby view always yields a new entry. A null view keeps it, so every
  App leave clears it; another room's first view drops it. App passes
  `cachedLobbyRules(cache, view)`; EndScreen passes `FinishedStateView.lobbyRules`.
- **Mount split.** `ArenaScreenProps` extends `TableScreenProps` (Appendix A.9.1), so App and
  EndScreen mount the two boards in their own branches; `TableScreen` keeps its props.
```


**Acceptance map:**
- A 180 s host turn is full at 180 s and half at 90 s: `scales the bar to a 180 s host turn: full at 180 s, half at 90 s (source 1)`.
- A 5 s turn starts full: `starts a 5 s host turn full, in --danger for its last 10 s`.
- A resume with the same `turnSequence` keeps the original length: `falls back to the first TURN_STARTED of the turn; a resume on the same turnSequence keeps its length (source 2, §4.1)`.
- The paused, absent and none labels render: `shows $text for $label, with an empty bar and no aria-valuenow` (×4).
- Seconds-only mode has no `aria-valuenow`: `shows seconds only, with no aria-valuenow, when no length is known (source 3)`.
- The pairing against the view current at receive time (Review line): the resume test and `ignores a payload left from the previous game at mount, then records the new turn (Play again in one room)`.
- The rules cache survives lobby → playing and clears on leave:
  - the hook tests `keeps the room's last lobby rules from the lobby into play, …` and `keeps the rules through a null view, clears them on leave, …`;
  - App: `hands the arena the room's lobby rules after START_GAME, and forgets them on leave (§6.10, §6.11, L74-21)`.
- Reduced motion, and opening nothing sends nothing: `sends nothing, and the fill jumps under reduced motion`.
- `pnpm verify` green: Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **`nowMs` is `props.nowMs`** (App's 250 ms tick) for both the countdown and `receivedAtMs`. No component reads the clock.
- **Clock look** (designer question, default): the label sits left of a 6 px bar inside the top bar's turn panel. The fill is `--cta` on a `--panel-2` track; the label and fill turn `--danger` in the last 10 s. The empty bar shows in every mode, as V2's did.
- **The record lives in the arena**, the cache in App (A.9.1). The arena remounts on the live → finished switch, where the clock is '—' anyway; a reconnect keeps the arena mounted (App keeps the view).
- **Mount guard.** At mount, a payload is recorded only when its deadline matches `view.turnDeadlineMs`. `useRoomConnection` keeps the previous game's payload across Play again in one room, and a stale record would block the first turn's real sighting (same `turnSequence`).
- **Solo is covered by the hook.** A solo launch shows Home while its lobby views reach `view`, so the same hook caches them. The L74-26 gate checks a solo non-60 s turn, in case React batches every lobby view away.
- **Leave clears the cache explicitly** (`nextRulesCache` keeps it on a null view by design). A kick or a failed join leaves it until the next room's first view drops it: harmless, because `cachedLobbyRules` checks the room code.
- **Test location.** `App.arena.test.tsx` is the first App behavior test. It mocks `./net/use-room-connection` with a hoisted fake (Appendix A.8 ruling 8 style); L74-23 and L74-25 extend it (D15).
- **Extra files (D15):** `use-lobby-rules-cache.ts` + test, `use-turn-started-record.ts`, `App.arena.test.tsx`, the `end.tsx` split and the `test-view.ts` defaults (`lastTurnStarted: null`, `cachedLobbyRules: null`, S2) are accepted beyond the brief.
- **New strings:** none. Reused: 'Turn timer', `TURN_CLOCK_*_LABEL` (V2 via L73), `${n}s`.

```tsx
 * Table rules recall: technical spec v7 §6.11, §7.4, §11 (Q15: excluded in words); Appendix A
 * `rules-recall-table-end` (L74-22). The live source is App's cached lobby rules; the finished

import type { LobbyRules } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { renderUi, type RenderUiResult } from '../../test/render';
import { makeFinishedView } from '../../view-model/test-fixtures';
import { EndScreen } from '../end';
import { STATUS_LABELS } from '../status-labels';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from './arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from './test-view';

const RULES: LobbyRules = { excludedKitIds: ['kamikaze', 'gambler'], randomOnly: true, turnTimeSeconds: 45 };

function renderArena(overrides: Partial<ArenaScreenProps>) {
  const props = makeArenaProps(overrides);
  return { props, ...renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />) };
}
async function openMenu(user: RenderUiResult['user']): Promise<HTMLElement> {
  const bar = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-arena-region="top-bar"]');
  if (bar === null) throw new Error('no top bar');
  await user.click(within(bar).getByRole('button', { name: 'Menu' }));
  return screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Menu' });
}

describe('Table rules recall (§6.11)', () => {
  it('lists Table rules after Action log and opens the read-only rules sheet, excluded kits named in words', async () => {
    const { user, props } = renderArena({ cachedLobbyRules: RULES });
    const menu = await openMenu(user);
    expect(within(menu).getAllByRole('button').map((button) => button.textContent)).toEqual(['How to play', 'Action log', 'Table rules', 'Copy']);
    await user.click(within(menu).getByRole('button', { name: 'Table rules' }));
    const sheet = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Table rules' });
    expect(sheet.getAttribute('data-arena-sheet')).toBe('rules');
    expect([within(sheet).getByText('45s'), within(sheet).getByText('Random')]).toHaveLength(2);
    const faces = [...sheet.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-kit-id]')];
    const excluded = faces.filter((face) => face.getAttribute('data-excluded') === 'true');
    expect(excluded.map((face) => [face.getAttribute('data-kit-id'), face.textContent.includes('Excluded')])).toEqual([['kamikaze', true], ['gambler', true]]);
    expect(faces.filter((face) => !excluded.includes(face)).some((face) => face.textContent.includes('Excluded'))).toBe(false);
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
  });

  it('hides the entry while the rules are unknown (a reload, a walk-in mid-game)', async () => {
    const { user } = renderArena({ cachedLobbyRules: null });
    const menu = await openMenu(user);
    expect(within(menu).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Table rules' })).toBeNull();
    expect(within(menu).getByRole('button', { name: 'How to play' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('reads FinishedStateView.lobbyRules on the finished board (EndScreen, ?ui=next)', async () => {
    // Game over opens after the banner timer: frozen here, so the board's menu stays on top.
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const view = makeFinishedView({ finalTable: makeArenaView(), lobbyRules: RULES });
    const { user } = renderUi(
      <EndScreen view={view} actionReject={null} onDismissActionReject={vi.fn()} statusLabel={STATUS_LABELS.connected} nowMs={0} onLeave={vi.fn()} tableUi="next" />,
      { advanceTimers: vi.advanceTimersByTime },
    );
    await user.click(within(await openMenu(user)).getByRole('button', { name: 'Table rules' }));
    const sheet = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Table rules' });
    expect(within(sheet).getByText('45s')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(sheet.querySelector('[data-kit-id="gambler"]')?.getAttribute('data-excluded')).toBe('true');
  });
});
```

```
## YYYY-MM-DD · [P] V7 Watching strip, claim reopen and POV elimination overlay (L74-23)

Source: technical spec v7 §6.3, §6.12, §7.2, §10.6, §13 (Q24, Q38); Appendix A
`walk-in-spectator-mode`, `table-prompts`, `claim-seat-dismiss-stay`; A.8 rulings 7 and 9; Lot 74
Part 1 final review (Minor 15, ledger 47, 48, 68).

- **Copy is V2's.** A walk-in reads V2's private-zone pair ('Watching this table. …' with a Spy
  overlay, 'Hands stay hidden …' without). An eliminated POV reads V2's 'Eliminated' prompt line in
  full ('You are a spectator. Actions are locked …'). The heading is L73's 'Watching'. The only
  new string is 'Claim a seat' (§10.6).
- **Reanimating** keeps the seated strip; its 'Reanimating' flow badge is the label, so no second
  heading repeats it.
- **Leave** reaches the top bar's confirm through a `confirmRequest` counter (Appendix A.9.4). The
  latch moved from a boolean ref reset on open to a per-open epoch, compared and set only in the
  confirm handler. It behaves the same (one press, one send; a reopened confirm sends again), and
  no ref is written during render.
- **Claim a seat** clears App's dismissed key. Kit fog stays the server's: after Stay the server
  keeps the overlay even when the picker returns (`stayConfirmedSpectators`), and the arena
  renders what it receives.
- **POV elimination overlay.** It shows on the Watching edge and on a first paint already
  Watching (the finished board, and a reload, as V2's banner seed did; designer 2026-11-02). It never renders under a
  sub-choice, takes no press or focus, and is an in-region layer, not a fixed one. The arena's
  banner host drops its You are dead cue (`deadCue={false}`, a `ui/` prop); the classic table
  keeps it.
- **Stale seat sheets** close when their player stops being an opponent, so `openSeatId` never
  names the POV (final review Minor 15).
```

**Acceptance map:**
- A walk-in sees Watching, no dock and Claim a seat while claimable seats exist; it is hidden when there are none:
  - `gives a walk-in Watching, Leave table and no dock; Claim a seat shows only with onReopenClaim and sends nothing`;
  - App gating: `reopens the claim picker from Claim a seat after Stay, only while claimable seats exist (§7.2, Q24, L74-23)`.
- Claim a seat reopens the picker after Stay: the same App test.
- A walk-in behind an open picker sees no kit: `shows a walk-in behind an open claim picker no kit and the hands-hidden line (L57-16)`.
  - Only the `HIDDEN` copy line of that test can fail before this task's code. The tier and anchor half holds already, because kit fog is the server's: a default `makeArenaView({ pov: 'walk-in' })` gives `tiers()` as `['unspied', 'unspied', 'unspied']`, and `opponent-seat.tsx` puts `data-hint-anchor="hidden-kit"` on each hidden-kit seat (Q66).
- An eliminated POV with `pendingReanimation` sees Reanimating with seated tiers: `labels an eliminated POV with pendingReanimation Reanimating, with the seated tiers, Unspy, no Watching and no overlay (§6.3)`.
- The elimination overlay does not render while a sub-choice is open and is skipped with `pendingReanimation`: `never renders while $label` (×2).
- Leave opens the flag confirm with the same latch: `opens the flag confirm from the %s strip’s Leave table, and Leave leaves once (A.9.4)` (×2), plus the ledger 47 / 48 pins in `top-bar.test.tsx`.
- Review line:
  - the overlay replaces the cue, is non-blocking and lasts at most ~1.6 s: `shows You are dead on the elimination edge for TABLE_BANNER_MS, takes no press, and replaces the banner` and `drops You are dead when deadCue is false, …`;
  - the eliminated Watching dock stays: `keeps an eliminated Watching POV its own strip, thumbs and dock under Watching, …` and L74-13's `an eliminated Watching POV keeps a disabled dock without Unspy (ruling 7)`.
- Zero legal actions and no Unspy: L74-01's `computes one action lock for $label` (walk-in, eliminated) and L74-13's dock tests.
- Final review Minor 15: `closes a seat sheet whose player became the POV, so no arrow lights for the POV` and the reducer test.
- The claim-seat source-text tests stay green: Step 4.
- `pnpm verify` green: Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **Walk-in strip:** heading, line, then Claim a seat (`primary`) and Leave table (`quiet`, flag icon, V2's 'Leave table' words) on a `--panel` chrome card. **Designer question:** button fills (default as described).
- **Overlay look:** 'You are dead' on a `--danger` slab with the banner's chrome, centred over the arena region, no scrim, static. **Designer question** (default as described; L78 restyles).
- **Overlay on a first paint already Watching** (the finished board, and a reload mid-game): **Designer 2026-11-02: shown everywhere** (the default, confirmed; not the finished board only), as V2's banner seed did.
- **Eliminated copy:** V2's full sentence ('You are a spectator. …'); the brief quotes only its second half.
- **No `resources` zone for a walk-in**, so the strip carries no empty anchor. Its hints and FX need own resources, which a walk-in has none of (Q38).
- **Kit fog** is never applied client-side (§6.3, "no client inference"). See the decisions entry.
- **`onReopenClaim`** (D13) is passed only to a walk-in (`isSpectator`) while `claimableSeats` is non-empty: the claim picker is walk-in-only during play (`shouldShowClaimPicker`). No `makeArenaProps` default (optional, S2).
- **`deadCue` is a `ui/` prop** (D12; default true), with a test and a `DESIGN.md` line: the brief's Review line requires the overlay to replace the cue on every POV elimination. Passing `isEliminated={false}` was rejected, because it misstates the input and `isEliminated` still feeds the Sentence banners.
- **The confirm latch (D11)** is a per-open epoch (`sentEpoch` ref, compared and set only in the confirm handler), because the React Compiler forbids re-arming a ref during render. Same semantics; ledger 47 and 48 pin it.
- **Reconnecting (S3, S11):** Leave table and Claim a seat stay enabled while the connection is reconnecting; both are App-level and buffered.
- **New strings:** 'Claim a seat' (§10.6). Reused: 'Watching', 'Reanimating', 'Leave table', 'You are dead', the three V2 lines.

```tsx
import type { ChatMessageView, FinishedStateView, PlayingStateView } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { act, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { markFeedbackAsked } from '../feedback/asked-storage';
import { renderUi, type RenderUiOptions } from '../test/render';
import { TABLE_BANNER_MS } from '../view-model/table-banner';
import { makeCard, makeFinishedView, makeSelf, type FinishedViewOverrides } from '../view-model/test-fixtures';
import { ArenaScreen } from './arena/arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from './arena/test-view';
import { EndScreen, type EndScreenProps } from './end';
import { STATUS_LABELS } from './status-labels';

const OPTIONS: RenderUiOptions = { reducedMotion: true, advanceTimers: vi.advanceTimersByTime };
function endProps(view: FinishedStateView, onLeave: () => void = vi.fn()): EndScreenProps {
  return { view, actionReject: null, onDismissActionReject: vi.fn(), statusLabel: STATUS_LABELS.connected, nowMs: 0, onLeave, tableUi: 'next' };
}
function renderEnd(finalTable: PlayingStateView, finished: FinishedViewOverrides = {}) {
  const onLeave = vi.fn<() => void>();
  return { ...renderUi(<EndScreen {...endProps(makeFinishedView({ finalTable, ...finished }), onLeave)} />, OPTIONS), onLeave };
}
function region(name: string): HTMLElement {
  const found = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-arena-region="${name}"]`);
  if (found === null) throw new Error(`no ${name} region`);
  return found;
}
const gameOver = (): HTMLElement | null => screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Game over' });
async function closeGameOver(user: ReturnType<typeof renderUi>['user']): Promise<void> {
  const dialog = gameOver();
  if (dialog === null) throw new Error('Game over is not open');
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'View board' }));
  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(gameOver()).toBeNull();
  });
}
const elapse = (ms: number): void => {
  act(() => {
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(ms);
  });
};

beforeEach(() => {
  localStorage.clear();
  vi.useFakeTimers();
});
afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});
```

**Acceptance map:**
- Stats reopens the stats and does nothing while Feedback is open: `reopens Game over from Stats, and Stats does nothing while Feedback is open (L47-03)`.
- Confirming the flag's Return home calls `requestLeave`: `confirms Return home on the flag through requestLeave: $label (L57-03)` (×2: the ask, then the direct leave).
- Every intent callback is a no-op: `sends nothing: no Draw, locked card actions, a browse-only Shop and a chat with no composer (Review Focus 5)`. EndScreen's own handlers stay `noop`.
- No chat composer renders: the same test.
- A POV elimination shows the overlay, not the banner: `shows the POV elimination overlay, never the You are dead banner, before Game over opens`.
- The `end.tsx` and `feedback-surfaces` source-text tests stay green: Step 4 (no `end.tsx` edit).
- Brief items:
  - the arena for `finalTable`, the clock '—', Stats in the dock: `mounts the arena on the final table: …`;
  - `!` only while stats are closed: `opens the manual Feedback from ! only while Game over is closed (L47-03)`;
  - win first paint: `shows You won! on first paint for a POV win, before Game over opens (L51-06)`;
  - `dockHasControls` with Stats: `gives a walk-in on the finished board a Stats-only dock (Q38)` and `counts Stats: …`.
- Review Focus 5 (the live → finished switch):
  - `keeps the chat unread count across the switch (Q48)`;
  - `replays no past elimination beat when the finished board mounts (Q63)`;
  - the sends-nothing test.
  - A reconnect does not remount the arena (App keeps the view), so the switch is the remount these tests cover.
- `pnpm verify` green: Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **Stats:** `primary`, no icon, last in the dock row. **Designer question** (default as described).
- **V2's Game over prompt card is not carried.** **Designer question** (default: none). See the decisions entry.
- **Test file location** (D14) is `screens/end.finished-board.test.tsx`, not the brief's `screens/arena/finished-board.test.tsx`: it sits beside the screen it drives, `end.tsx`.
- **Double tap on Stats** opens Game over, and the second tap may land on V2's Game over backdrop (no entrance shield) and close it. That is V2 parity; the L74-26 gate records it.
- **New strings:** none. Reused: 'Stats' (V2), 'Return home', 'Return home?', 'Game over', 'View board', 'Feedback', 'You won!', 'You are dead'.

```ts
export interface RejectCue { readonly instanceId: string; readonly reject: ActionRejectPayload }
/** §6.6.2: the held card the last send spent, when the reject arrives before any state update since that send. */

// reconnect-banner.tsx
```

```ts
/**
 * Which card springs back after a reject: technical spec v7 §6.6.2, §6.12; Part 2 Review Focus 4 (L74-25).
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import type { ActionRejectPayload } from '../../net/use-room-connection';
import { makeCard, makePlayingView, makeSelf } from '../../view-model/test-fixtures';
import { rejectCueFor } from './reject-model';

const REJECT: ActionRejectPayload = { code: 'not-your-turn', message: 'Not your turn.' };
const VIEW = makePlayingView({ self: makeSelf({ hand: [makeCard('spy')], specialCards: [makeCard('poison')] }) });

describe('rejectCueFor (L74-25)', () => {
  it('names the held card the last send spent when no state update came since, hand or specials', () => {
    expect(rejectCueFor({ instanceId: 'spy-1', view: VIEW }, VIEW, REJECT)).toEqual({ instanceId: 'spy-1', reject: REJECT });
    expect(rejectCueFor({ instanceId: 'poison-1', view: VIEW }, VIEW, REJECT)).toEqual({ instanceId: 'poison-1', reject: REJECT });
  });
  it('is null with no send, a send that spent no card (Draw), or a card no longer held', () => {
    expect(rejectCueFor(null, VIEW, REJECT)).toBeNull();
    expect(rejectCueFor({ instanceId: null, view: VIEW }, VIEW, REJECT)).toBeNull();
    expect(rejectCueFor({ instanceId: 'gone-1', view: VIEW }, VIEW, REJECT)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('is null once a state update arrived after the send: that send was accepted', () => {
    expect(rejectCueFor({ instanceId: 'spy-1', view: VIEW }, { ...VIEW }, REJECT)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
/**
 * Server rejects in the arena: technical spec v7 §6.6.2, §6.12, §8.3; Appendix A `illegal-action-dialog`,
 * `reject-state-carryover`, `table-subchoice-gate-reject-copy`; Part 2 Review Focus 4 (L74-25).

import type { PlayingStateView } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { act, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import type { ActionRejectPayload } from '../../net/use-room-connection';
import { renderUi, type RenderUiOptions } from '../../test/render';
import { makeCard, makeSelf } from '../../view-model/test-fixtures';
import { ILLEGAL_ACTION_COPY } from '../illegal-action-copy';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from './arena-screen';
import { REJECT_TOAST_MS } from './reject-model';
import { makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from './test-view';

const NOT_YOUR_TURN: ActionRejectPayload = { code: 'not-your-turn', message: 'Not your turn.' };
const ALREADY_ACTED: ActionRejectPayload = { code: 'already-acted', message: 'Already acted.' };
const handView = (): PlayingStateView => makeArenaView({ overrides: { self: makeSelf({ points: 30, hand: [makeCard('spy'), makeCard('tax')] }) } });
function setup(view: PlayingStateView, overrides: Partial<ArenaScreenProps> = {}, options: RenderUiOptions = {}) {
  const props = makeArenaProps({ view, ...overrides });
  return { props, ...renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />, options) };
}
function region(name: string): HTMLElement {
  const element = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-arena-region="${name}"]`);
  if (element === null) throw new Error(`no ${name} region`);
  return element;
}
const handCard = (name: string): HTMLElement => within(region('hand')).getByRole('button', { name });
const draw = (): HTMLElement => within(region('dock')).getByRole('button', { name: /^Draw, plus / });
const toastShows = (title: string): boolean => within(screen.getByRole('alert')).queryByText(title) !== null;

describe('reject toast (§6.12)', () => {
  it('shows the ILLEGAL_ACTION_COPY title and body in an error toast, not a modal', () => {
    setup(makeArenaView(), { actionReject: NOT_YOUR_TURN });
    const alert = screen.getByRole('alert');
    expect(within(alert).getByText('Not your turn')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(alert).getByText(ILLEGAL_ACTION_COPY['not-your-turn'].body)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('keeps the toast across a state update and dismisses it once by OK (Review Focus 4)', async () => {
    const { user, props, rerender } = setup(makeArenaView(), { actionReject: NOT_YOUR_TURN });
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} view={{ ...props.view, turnSequence: props.view.turnSequence + 1 }} />);
    expect(toastShows('Not your turn')).toBe(true);
    expect(props.onDismissActionReject).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'OK' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'OK' }));
    expect(props.onDismissActionReject).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('dismisses itself once after REJECT_TOAST_MS, also over an open card sheet whose focus trap keeps Tab off OK (watch point)', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const { user, props, rerender } = setup(handView(), {}, { advanceTimers: vi.advanceTimersByTime });
    await user.click(handCard('Tax'));
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} actionReject={ALREADY_ACTED} />);
    act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(REJECT_TOAST_MS - 1); });
    expect(props.onDismissActionReject).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(1 + REJECT_TOAST_MS); });
    expect(props.onDismissActionReject).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it.each([{ reducedMotion: false, cue: 'shake' }, { reducedMotion: true, cue: 'flash' }])(
    'a rejected Spy play marks its hand card: $cue (reduced motion $reducedMotion; §6.6.2, §8.3)',
    async ({ reducedMotion, cue }) => {
      const { user, props, rerender } = setup(handView(), {}, { reducedMotion });
      await user.click(handCard('Spy'));
      await user.click(within(screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Spy' })).getByRole('button', { name: /^Use/ }));
      await user.click(within(region('arena')).getByRole('button', { name: 'p2, target' }));
      expect(vi.mocked(props.onPlayCard).mock.calls).toEqual([['spy-1', { targetPlayerId: 'p2' }]]);
      expect(handCard('Spy').closest('[data-reject-cue]')).toBeNull();
      rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} actionReject={NOT_YOUR_TURN} />);
      expect(handCard('Spy').closest('[data-reject-cue]')?.getAttribute('data-reject-cue')).toBe(cue);
      expect(handCard('Tax').closest('[data-reject-cue]')).toBeNull();
    },
  );

  it('a Draw reject with no state update re-arms the Draw latch and shakes no card (Review Focus 4)', async () => {
    const { user, props, rerender } = setup(handView());
    await user.click(draw());
    await user.click(draw());
    expect(props.onDraw).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} actionReject={ALREADY_ACTED} />);
    await user.click(draw());
    expect(props.onDraw).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-reject-cue]')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
/**
 * Reconnecting: technical spec v7 §6.12; Appendix A `global-room-connection-lifecycle`,
 * `global-page-reload-recovery`; Part 2 Review Focus 3 (L74-25).
 */
import type { PlayingStateView, SubChoiceRequiredPayload } from '@card-battle/shared';
import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { renderUi } from '../../test/render';
import { DISABLED_REASON_COPY } from '../../view-model/action-reasons';
import { makeCard, makePending, makeSelf } from '../../view-model/test-fixtures';
import { ArenaScreen, type ArenaScreenProps } from './arena-screen';
import { expectNoArenaIntent, makeArenaProps, makeArenaView } from './test-view';

const handView = (): PlayingStateView => makeArenaView({ overrides: { self: makeSelf({ points: 30, hand: [makeCard('spy'), makeCard('tax')] }) } });
function setup(view: PlayingStateView, overrides: Partial<ArenaScreenProps> = {}) {
  const props = makeArenaProps({ view, ...overrides });
  const result = renderUi(<ArenaScreen {...props} />);
  const status = (connectionStatus: ArenaScreenProps['connectionStatus'], next: Partial<ArenaScreenProps> = {}): void => {
    result.rerender(<ArenaScreen {...props} {...next} connectionStatus={connectionStatus} />);
  };
  return { props, status, ...result };
}
function region(name: string): HTMLElement {
  const element = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-arena-region="${name}"]`);
  if (element === null) throw new Error(`no ${name} region`);
  return element;
}
const handCard = (name: string): HTMLElement => within(region('hand')).getByRole('button', { name });
const sheet = (name: string): HTMLElement => screen.getByRole('dialog', { name });
const use = (name: string): HTMLElement => within(sheet(name)).getByRole('button', { name: /^Use/ });
const draw = (): HTMLElement => within(region('dock')).getByRole('button', { name: /^Draw, plus / });
const banner = (): Element | null => document.querySelector('[data-zone="reconnect-banner"]');
const isDisabled = (button: HTMLElement): boolean => button.hasAttribute('disabled') || button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';

describe('reconnecting (§6.12, Review Focus 3)', () => {
  it('shows Reconnecting… and locks Draw and an open sheet’s Use, then unlocks both', async () => {
    const { user, props, status } = setup(handView());
    expect([banner()?.getAttribute('role'), banner()?.textContent]).toEqual(['status', '']);
    await user.click(handCard('Tax'));
    expect(isDisabled(use('Tax'))).toBe(false);
    status('reconnecting');
    expect(banner()?.textContent).toBe('Reconnecting…');
    expect(within(sheet('Tax')).getByRole('button', { name: /^Use/, description: DISABLED_REASON_COPY['actions-locked'] })).not.toBeNull();
    expect([isDisabled(use('Tax')), isDisabled(draw())]).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(document.querySelector('main')?.getAttribute('data-action-lock')).toBe('actions-locked');
    await user.click(use('Tax'));
    await user.click(draw());
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
    status('connected');
    expect(banner()?.textContent).toBe('');
    expect([isDisabled(use('Tax')), isDisabled(draw())]).toEqual([false, false]);
  });

  it('ends targeting when the connection drops; a seat tap then sends nothing', async () => {
    const { user, props, status } = setup(handView());
    await user.click(handCard('Spy'));
    await user.click(use('Spy'));
    expect(screen.queryByText('Choose a target')).not.toBeNull();
    status('reconnecting');
    expect([screen.queryByText('Choose a target'), document.querySelector('[data-target-seat]')]).toEqual([null, null]);
    await user.click(within(region('arena')).getByRole('button', { name: 'p1' }));
    status('connected');
    expect(document.querySelector('[data-target-seat]')).toBeNull();
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
  });

  it('locks the open sub-choice’s Confirm while reconnecting, then unlocks it', async () => {
    const mirror: SubChoiceRequiredPayload = { kind: 'mirror', eligibleEffectIds: ['atk-p1'], deadlineMs: 40_000 };
    const view = makeArenaView({ overrides: { pendingEffects: [makePending({ id: 'atk-p1', sourcePlayerId: 'p1', targetPlayerId: 'me', cardId: 'basic-attack' })] } });
    const { user, props, status } = setup(view, { subChoice: mirror });
    const confirm = (): HTMLElement => screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirm redirect' }); // L74-18's Mirror Confirm
    status('reconnecting');
    expect(isDisabled(confirm())).toBe(true);
    await user.click(confirm());
    expectNoArenaIntent(props);
    status('connected');
    await user.click(confirm());
    expect(props.onResolveSubChoice).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('a Draw latched before the drop re-arms on the state push after the reconnect (final review note)', async () => {
    const { user, props, status } = setup(makeArenaView());
    await user.click(draw());
    await user.click(draw());
    status('reconnecting');
    status('connected');
    await user.click(draw());
    expect(props.onDraw).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); // same view: the latch holds until the rejoin's state push
    status('connected', { view: { ...props.view } }); // CLIENT_READY → sendStateTo (game-room.ts:490)
    await user.click(draw());
    expect(props.onDraw).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('keeps Forfeit, chat Enter and a walk-in’s Claim a seat available while reconnecting (S3, S11, Review Focus 3)', async () => {
    const { user, props, status, unmount } = setup(handView());
    status('reconnecting');
    await user.click(within(region('top-bar')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Forfeit' }));
    await user.click(within(sheet('Leave the game?')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Forfeit' }));
    expect(props.onForfeit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Leave the game?' })).toBeNull();
    });
    await user.click(within(region('top-bar')).getByRole('button', { name: /^Chat/ }));
    await user.type(within(sheet('Chat')).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' }), 'gg{Enter}');
    expect(vi.mocked(props.onSendChat).mock.calls).toEqual([['gg']]);
    unmount();
    const onReopenClaim = vi.fn<() => void>();
    const walkIn = setup(makeArenaView({ pov: 'walk-in' }), { onReopenClaim });
    walkIn.status('reconnecting');
    await walkIn.user.click(within(region('self-strip')).getByRole('button', { name: 'Claim a seat' }));
    expect(onReopenClaim).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```markdown
## YYYY-MM-DD · [P] V7 reconnect lock and reject toast (L74-25)

Source: technical spec v7 §6.6.2, §6.12, §8.3; Lot 74 plan A.9.5; Part 2 Review Focus 3 and 4;
backlog L74-25 watch point; the Part 1 re-review note on a null-room send.

- **Reconnecting locks game intents only (designer 2026-11-02).** `ActionContext.reconnecting` makes `actionLock` return
  `actions-locked` (never `readOnly`, which would turn the dock into the Stats dock). The sub-choice
  host disables its commit buttons (`locked`), and the commit helper's `allow` drops any send.
  Leave table, Forfeit, Return home, chat, Claim a seat and Stay stay available. They do not depend
  on a board the player cannot see, and
  `@colyseus/sdk` 0.17 buffers sends while the socket reconnects (`Room.send` → `enqueueMessage`, up
  to 10, replayed on rejoin). A buffered card play would replay against a state the player has not
  seen: that is the hazard the lock removes. L75 composes `allow` with `allowTutorialSend`.
- **A null-room send.** `roomRef.current` is null only after a leave, which unmounts the arena and
  its latches. While reconnecting the SDK buffers instead of dropping. A Draw latched just before
  a drop re-arms on the rejoin's state push (`CLIENT_READY` → `sendStateTo`, `game-room.ts:490`), a
  new view for `useCommitOnce`. The latch does not change.
- **Every reject toast times out** (`REJECT_TOAST_MS`, 6 s). While a sheet is live, its focus trap
  keeps Tab inside the panel, so OK is not keyboard-reachable (watch point). Letting `reachableIn`
  admit the toast was rejected: it would change the modal focus contract of every sheet.
- **Spring-back key.** The card that shakes is the one the last send spent (`onSent`'s context),
  and only when the reject arrives before any state update since that send. A reject after an
  accepted intent, or after a Draw, shakes nothing. Reduced motion flashes `--danger` instead.
- **A second reject while the toast is open** swaps the copy in place and keeps the running timer:
  the `Toast` never restarts it on a prop change.
- The classic board keeps `IllegalActionDialog` until L75.

---
```

**Acceptance map:**
- Reconnecting renders the banner and disables Draw and Use → `reconnect-banner.test.tsx` › "shows Reconnecting… and locks Draw and an open sheet’s Use, then unlocks both".
- A `stateUpdate` with an open reject keeps the toast → `reject-toast.test.tsx` › "keeps the toast across a state update …".
- Manual and timed dismissal each call `clearActionReject` once → "… dismisses it once by OK …" and "dismisses itself once after REJECT_TOAST_MS …".
- The exhaustive `ILLEGAL_ACTION_COPY` test still passes → `illegal-action-copy.test.ts`, unchanged (Step 4).
- A rejected Spy play marks its hand card for spring-back, and reduced motion uses no shake → "a rejected Spy play marks its hand card: shake / flash"; `reject-model.test.ts`.
- Review Focus 3 → the locked half: `reconnect-banner.test.tsx` (sheet open, targeting live, sub-choice Confirm, re-enable) and `hand-drag.test.ts` › "sends nothing when the connection dropped mid-drag". The stays-available half (S3, S11): `reconnect-banner.test.tsx` › "keeps Forfeit, chat Enter and a walk-in’s Claim a seat available while reconnecting (S3, S11, Review Focus 3)" (the top-bar Forfeit and its confirm call `onForfeit`, chat Enter calls `onSendChat`, Claim a seat calls `onReopenClaim`).
- Review Focus 4 → "keeps the toast across a state update …", "a rejected Spy play …", "a Draw reject with no state update re-arms the Draw latch …".
- The null-room note → `reconnect-banner.test.tsx` › "a Draw latched before the drop re-arms …"; decisions.md.
- App passes the raw status (A.9.1) → `App.arena.test.tsx` › "passes the raw connection status to the arena: …".
- `pnpm verify` green → Step 6.

**Decisions:**
- **What locks while reconnecting (S3, S11).** Every arena intent and every sub-choice answer locks. Leave table, Forfeit, Return home, chat, Claim a seat and Stay stay available. Reason: SDK buffering, and a stuck player must be able to leave. **Designer 2026-11-02:** Forfeit and the chat Send are not locked while reconnecting (the default, confirmed).
- **`allow` (D5).** L74-25 sets `allow: () => !reconnecting`; L75 composes it with `allowTutorialSend` and never replaces it.
- **Only `'reconnecting'` shows the banner and locks.** `disconnected` and `failed` take App off the board.
- **The banner is in flow above the top bar**, not an overlay: it pushes the board down while shown and covers no control. **Designer question:** an overlay strip instead? Default: in flow.
- **Toast:** `tone="error"`, `dismissLabel` "OK" (V2's button, verbatim), `timeoutMs` 6000. **Designer question:** the duration. Default: 6 s, long enough for a two-sentence body.
- **Spring-back look:** a ±8 px shake over `--dur-slow` (400 ms); under reduced motion a 3 px `--danger` ring fading over the same time. Both run on the card wrapper in place, so focus stays.
- **The spring-back is keyed on the last send before any state update**, so an accepted intent never shakes on a later, unrelated reject (for example a rejected forfeit).
- **A second reject while open** swaps the copy and keeps the timer.
- **New strings:** none. "Reconnecting…" (`STATUS_LABELS`), "OK" (V2 `IllegalActionDialog`), the `ILLEGAL_ACTION_COPY` titles and bodies, and "Actions locked" (`DISABLED_REASON_COPY`) are all existing copy.

**Decisions:**
- **Integration before the gate (S10).** Step 1 runs first, so the gate verifies what ships. It merges `origin/dev` rather than rebasing (the Lot 72 precedent): every L74 commit appends to `decisions.md` and moves the backlog Total, as Lot 80 does, so a rebase would stop at nearly every commit, while a merge resolves each shared file once.
- **Reconnect without a reload:** the SDK's `offline` listener (`@colyseus/sdk` `Connection`) closes with `MAY_TRY_RECONNECT`. The gate dispatches that event instead of cutting the network or stopping a server another session might share.
- **Gate servers** run through local `.claude/launch.json` entries that are never committed, because the committed preview config is shared.
- **Pushing and opening the PR wait for the developer's explicit yes** (Step 6.6).
- **New strings:** none unless a fix adds one; list it in the PR.

renames or reshapes anything below. Part 2 (L74-14 … L74-26) extends these modules; it never breaks them.

below are final: the controller's consistency rulings of 2026-10-28 are folded in.
